items.sum: Sanofi and Regeneron both scored in the rare disease space while Lilly's dealmaking streak continued.

items.t: With FDA nod, Regeneron brings an RNAi drug to autoimmune disease
items.sum: The product of a collaboration with Alnylam, Livsayis is now Regeneron’s first marketed RNAi drug and will compete against established medicines from AstraZeneca and Argenx.

items.t: REGN Gets FDA Nod for Livsayis in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis
items.sum: Regeneron's Livsayis becomes the first and only siRNA therapy approved by the FDA for generalized myasthenia gravis, offering four subcutaneous doses a year.

items.t: Regeneron Wins FDA Nod For Livsayis, 4x-Year GMG Shot
items.sum: On Wednesday, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved Regeneron Pharmaceuticals Inc.’s (NASDAQ:REGN) Livsayis (cemdisiran) for generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) in adults who test positive for anti-acetylcholine receptor (AChR) antibodies, the predominant form of the disease.
